query: INSERT INTO route_probes (route,route_version,document_digest,probed_by,ok,observed) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) ON CONFLICT (route) DO UPDATE SET route_version=EXCLUDED.route_version, document_digest=EXCLUDED.document_digest, probed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, probed_by=EXCLUDED.probed_by, ok=EXCLUDED.ok, observed=EXCLUDED.observed RETURNING probed_at
